create_mc_agent_memory: create an MCAgentMemory instance with in-memory database and loaded Minecraft specs, block types, and mob types
get_block_object_by_xyz: get a BlockObjectNode from the memory store by querying its x, y, z coordinates
upsert_block: upsert a block voxel into VoxelObjects table with block data, metadata, and placement flags
convert_block_object_to_schematic: convert an existing BlockObject memory node into a SchematicNode and link them via triple store
set_mob_position: set or create a MobNode in memory by updating position, yaw, and pitch from a mob entity
